sources.title: Swampland constraints on neutrino masses

evidence.text: Follow families of minima under mass/cosmological-constant scans. For quintessence, evaluate the field-metric gradient norm of the two-scalar potential and test the absolute-value bound, especially near ∂R V = 0.

evidence.text: Tests the AdS distance conjecture through families of effective theories: homogeneous rescaling of all neutrino masses at fixed cosmological constant, with 10⁻⁴ < λ < 1, and non-homogeneous scanning that changes only the lightest neutrino mass.

evidence.text: Dimensional reduction of λΦ²ΨcΨ/M*² gives M = πRM*²/(2λ) and exhibits equal Weinberg-type couplings of the scalar zero mode to the neutrino tower.

sources.title: Constraining the EW Hierarchy from the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Substitute a valid mass-generation relation into a mass inequality and solve for the order parameter. Track fixed parameters explicitly: a quadratic seesaw map and a linear Dirac map produce different powers, and vanishing couplings can eliminate the constraint.

sources.title: Swampland constraints on neutrino masses

sources.title: Fermion masses and mixings in string theory with Dirac neutrinos

evidence.text: Worldsheet instantons generate Yukawas with area suppression exp(−Aijk T). Couplings are expressed through products of Jacobi theta functions. For Model 22, all relevant disk intersections lie on the first torus; the other tori contribute an overall factor irrelevant to mass ratios.

sources.title: Flavor structure from ‘canonical’ Yukawa interactions and ‘emergent’ kinetic terms

evidence.text: Factor kinetic matrices as k=X†X and use invertible field redefinitions to move flavor information between noncanonical kinetic coefficients and ordinary Yukawa matrices. Arbitrary complex matrices W parameterize the nonuniqueness of this representation.
